name.zh-CN: 机械三视图生成与检查；语义拓扑角色及来源诊断

description: Request actual Front, Top, and Left views and, when required, a principal-plane Section A-A from the validated EngineeringModel v2 final CadQuery/OCP body through formal SpatialModel, ProjectionModel, VisibilityModel, and DrawingModel gates, including countersinks and derived pattern instances. and generic planar Line/Arc Sweep results, including bounded curved-edge projection and formal section evidence. For Loft output, inspect the current OCP-derived Spatial/Projection/Visibility/DrawingModel result in Front/Top/Left and request a real Section A-A through each relevant transition when section dimensions are otherwise unobservable. G7C: reference generated topology only within fixed-binormal planar Line/Arc Sweeps and aligned ruled Lofts; Hole uses caps only, while Fillet/Chamfer uses an explicit intersection of generated face roles. Preserve source Feature, role, and Sketch entity/adjacent ordered-section IDs; never persist OCP Face/Edge ordinals. Re-resolve with tolerances after rebuild and fail closed on zero or multiple matches.
trigger: an internal feature or machining depth is not observable in the three orthographic views
execution_steps: Call the formal three-view drawing endpoint
Verify distinct Front, Top, and Left views in the formal DrawingModel and SVG
Retain the projection method and model fingerprint
Include exact rebuilt Hole, Counterbore, non-Z-axis, and Pattern geometry in the same single-body three-view pipeline
Verify views are rebuilt from the treated B-Rep after every ordered Fillet/Chamfer operation; do not draw rounded corners in the renderer.

For Revolve bodies, verify axial and side views from formal Spatial/Projection/Visibility/Drawing evidence; preserve circles and straight stepped-profile edges when analytically projected and require reported tolerance for derived curves.

When a requirement is not observable in Front/Top/Left, ask for or use an explicit principal-plane section axis, offset in millimetres, and viewing direction; never infer a cutting plane from the screen.
Verify Section A-A comes from a read-only OCP section of the current validated parametric rebuild, shares the DrawingModel with Front/Top/Left, and hatches only even-odd material regions.
Keep oblique, stepped, and revolved sections deferred unless a formal geometry contract supports them.
After validated rebuild and frozen Front/Top/Left projections, resolve requested dimensions from stable typed feature parameters or verified body geometry.
Select a view that contains an exact matching projection witness; if no unique witness exists, record the required section/auxiliary view or UNSUPPORTED instead of guessing.
Rebuild the association index and layouts after every upstream feature edit; remove dimensions for suppressed or deleted sources.
Keep the single DrawingModel as the common source for SVG and DXF and retain G6A section limitations.

Verify countersink cone faces and ExplicitPlacementPattern instances come from the actual final OCP body and flow through formal HLR/Spatial/Projection/Visibility evidence; use a supported section when the cone or internal depth is not visible in an orthographic view.
Keep countersink geometry status separate from annotation status; if the DrawingModel lacks a typed linked mouth-diameter/angle callout, report annotation support as PARTIAL.

For Sweep geometry, verify the actual rebuilt curved B-Rep through Front/Top/Left and Section A-A; retain the declared 0.01 mm HLR and 0.05 mm Spatial sampled-curve bounds where applicable, and report internal/path dimensions not uniquely visible as NOT_OBSERVABLE_IN_CURRENT_DRAWING.
Verify Loft drawing views and section geometry come from the same current EngineeringModel fingerprint and final validated OCP body.
For a generated Sweep/Loft reference, capture the source Feature, semantic face role, Sketch entity identity, or adjacent ordered Loft section pair from the EngineeringModel.
validation_gates: Projection consistency and visibility validation pass
All three formal views belong to the same DrawingModel
Require current model identity and all three views after every full-history feature rebuild
Fillet/Chamfer geometry must be visible from the final rebuilt shape; model-response completion alone is not drawing completion.
A valid Revolve kernel body alone is insufficient: all three views must be generated from the current final feature history, with visibility and derived-curve evidence preserved.
Do not label a model complete when requested internal dimensions remain unobservable or lack typed feature-linked annotation.
Every visible parametric dimension resolves against current EngineeringModel v2 and validated Spatial/Projection evidence.
A requested blind depth may be ANNOTATED_FROM_VALIDATED_FEATURE while remaining unobservable in ordinary orthographic geometry.
No stale association survives an upstream rebuild.
Do not infer a countersink mouth diameter or included angle from a projected cone; require validated analytic B-Rep or typed DrawingModel evidence.
Pattern placement views must contain the expected actual projected geometry count and current model fingerprint.
A projected Sweep outline does not prove its hidden section size or full path definition; require an appropriate section or STEP geometric evidence when those values are internal or ambiguous.
Any Loft claim requires actual ordered section references and the validated current EngineeringModel rebuild; never infer unsupported topology or hidden section size.
Generated face and edge roles re-resolve against current source geometry with explicit tolerances; zero or multiple matches fail closed, with no persisted OCP ordinals.
failure_policy: Propagate the actual SCC-SPAT or SCC-DRW code
Do not bypass a failed drawing gate
On stale, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported topology, preserve the original error code and stop; never retarget by face/edge order.
G7C：在固定 binormal 的平面 Line/Arc Sweep 与 aligned ruled Loft 范围内引用生成拓扑；Hole 仅使用端盖，Fillet/Chamfer 使用明确的生成面交线。所有引用保留来源 Feature、角色及草图实体/相邻有序截面 ID，不保存 OCP Face/Edge 编号；上游重建后按公差重解析，零匹配或多匹配必须失败关闭。
